evaluations.rationale: Music discovery via fingerprinting is distinct from other search/discovery stories by method.
Profile-based music discovery differs from content-based, similar-user, metadata, and recommendation stories.
Similar-user music discovery is not the same as receiving content recommendations from similar profiles; goal and output differ.
Query-by-music-video and ringback-tone discovery is a different context from fingerprinting or profile-based discovery.
Metadata/image-tag-based discovery is a distinct business rule from content fingerprinting or profile-based methods.
Uploading tagged videos for downstream processing is not expressed by another story.
Thumbnail sequence viewing is distinct from segmentation editing or similar-item retrieval.
ZO-009 expresses substantially the same user goal for similar video items/segments; 'perceptually' is not a meaningful enough difference.

evaluations.evidence: perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: This is substantially contained in ZO-008; the similarity qualifier does not establish a distinct actor, context, goal, permission, or business rule.
Recommendations from similar profiles differ from music search/discovery and location-based or image-based recommendations.
News-area-based recommendation is distinct from profile-based and media-based recommendation stories.
Person identification in videos is distinct from product, broadcaster-logo, or brand identification.
Product identification is distinct from person, broadcaster-logo, and brand identification.
Broadcaster-logo identification is a different object type from persons, products, or general brands.
Brand identification is distinct from broadcaster-logo identification despite thematic overlap.
Image-query video recommendation is distinct from music-video query and geographic/content search.
Geographic map access to videos is distinct from news-area recommendation and image query.
ASR-based search is distinct from fingerprinting and metadata discovery.
Admin segmentation validation/editing is distinct from annotation/topic extraction and user thumbnail viewing.
Topic extraction from news segments is distinct from segmentation editing and A/V filtering.
A/V-quality filtering/ranking is a distinct admin requirement from asset-based prefiltering.
Audio edit detection is distinct from copyright validation and audio denoising.
Nudity prefiltering is a distinct content rule from low-/high-level asset search.
Low-level asset search is distinct from high-level metadata/tag search and from nudity prefiltering.
Copyright infringement validation is distinct from audio edit assessment and content filtering.
High-level metadata/tag search is a different business rule from low-level asset search.
Picture interest/complexity assessment is distinct from prompting a scientist to look at a subject.
Scientist prompt detection is a distinct goal, even though it uses Talk comments/annotations.
Volunteer type identification is distinct from classification-weight assessment.
Galaxy Zoo preclassification is domain-specific and distinct from Snapshot Serengeti or Plankton tasks.
Detecting empty Snapshot Serengeti images is domain-specific and differs from Plankton empty-image detection.
Timestamping malfunction detection is distinct from other Snapshot Serengeti analysis stories.
Species preclassification is distinct from attribute preclassification and number detection.
Animal attribute preclassification is distinct from species and number detection.
Animal number detection is distinct from species and attribute preclassification.
Plankton segmentation/localization is distinct from size/orientation and species classification.
Detecting empty Plankton Portal images is domain-specific and distinct from Snapshot Serengeti empty images.
Plankton size/orientation detection is distinct from segmentation and species preclassification.
Plankton species preclassification is distinct from other Plankton analysis tasks.
Worm motion analysis is distinct from egg-laying detection in Worm Watch Lab.
Egg-laying time detection is distinct from general worm motion analysis.
Satellite feature detection is distinct from generic moving-object detection and geographic video access.
Volunteer classification weighting is distinct from volunteer type identification.
Artefact removal in images is distinct from moving-object detection and preclassification.
Moving/transient object detection is distinct from artefact removal and satellite feature detection.
Audio denoising is distinct from whale call grouping and whale counting.
Whale-call grouping is a domain-specific context distinct from generic subject grouping.
Whale counting is distinct from grouping similar whale calls and audio denoising.
When-to-interrupt is distinct from whether-to-interrupt and when-to-educate.
Interruption medium is distinct from interruption timing and education medium.
When-to-educate is distinct from when-to-interrupt and education-medium stories.
Education medium is distinct from interruption medium and education timing.
Which education to give is distinct from when/whether to educate.
Detecting interesting volunteer comments is distinct from Zoonibot comment timing.
Zoonibot comment timing is distinct from explanation timing and message content.
Explanation timing is a distinct action from general commenting and from what Zoonibot says.
Zoonibot message content is distinct from when to comment or explain.
Generic subject grouping is not duplicative of whale-call grouping because context differs meaningfully.
Volunteer project recommendation is distinct from content recommendation and volunteer weighting.
Article summary/reuse is distinct from news segment topic extraction and other admin stories.
